name: Marvin Richardson
desc: American politician from Idaho who legally changed his name to "Pro-Life" to show his opposition to abortion on ballot papers
summary: Pro-Life (born Marvin Thomas Richardson; August 5, 1941) is an American perennial candidate and strawberry farmer known for his strong opposition to abortion, which inspired him to legally change his name. He lives in the unincorporated community of Letha, Idaho. He has made several unsuccessful runs for political office in Idaho and has stated his intention to continue running for office until his death.
